title: Velvety Thai Turkey Ham Curry
description: A rich and creamy Thai curry featuring turkey ham, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made dairy-free friendly by using coconut milk instead of traditional dairy products. The combination of turkey ham, Thai red curry paste, and coconut milk creates a velvety and aromatic sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the diced turkey ham and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil leaves.
Serve the curry hot over rice or noodles.
